diagrams.title: Plan lifecycle (intended): draft -m-> ready (mark only) -m/go-> active (SPAWN) -m/done-> done; spawn re-sequenced off ready onto go

Intended control flow: m move dispatches mark-ready / go-spawn / project-UAT; Phase-B done-archive + Phase-C reload auto-pickup (cap two-branch); spawn + pickup are launched claude -p, never CLI state-flips
